annotation.title_clean: 国家医保局 民政部 财政部 人力资源社会保障部 农业农村部 国家卫生健康委 国家税务总局 中国残疾人联合会关于印发《加快建立长期护理保险制度实施方案》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the National Healthcare Security Administration and Other Departments on Issuing the Implementation Plan for Accelerating the Establishment of a Long-Term Care Insurance System
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家医保局 et al. (National Healthcare Security Administration, Ministry of Civil Affairs, Ministry of Finance, MOHRSS, MARA, NHC, STA, China Disabled Persons' Federation)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese multi-agency notice issuing the implementation plan for a national long-term care insurance system: coverage, financing (about 0.3% contribution rate), benefits, assessment, fund management and supervision. Only a passing mention that smart services and assistive devices may later be covered; no AI or robot governance.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establish a unified national long-term care insurance system within about three years
Contribution rate about 0.3%, shared between employers and individuals; government subsidies for non-employed residents
Benefits for severely disabled people, with fund payment of about 50–70% of eligible care costs
Designated care providers, unified disability assessment and strict fund supervision
Future study of covering intelligent care services and assistive devices
